descriptionChirho: To raise a joyful shout of praise, acclamation, or celebration, typically directed toward God in worship (Hifil stem in liturgical/celebratory contexts).
To raise a loud shout or cry, whether as a war cry in battle, a cry of distress, or a general loud vocalization (Hifil stem in non-liturgical contexts).
To blow or sound a signal alarm, especially with trumpets for mustering troops or signaling danger (Hifil stem in military/signal contexts, as in Numbers 10).
To shout exultantly in victory or triumph over enemies (Hitpael reflexive stem, emphasizing personal exultation and triumphal celebration).
To be the object of shouting or acclamation; the passive of raising a shout (Pual passive stem).
